draft.title: Globalisation and flows
card: Globalisation is the growing connection between places around the world. It happens as more goods, money, people and ideas move between them.
products traded across borders, such as phones made in one country and sold in another.
investment, loans and payments sent between countries, often within seconds by computer.
people move to travel, study or work, while news, ideas and information cross the world online. Better transport and technology make all these flows faster and cheaper.
draft.remember: Globalisation links distant places through flows of goods, money, people and ideas.

a.q: Which example is a flow of money between countries?
opts: A Japanese company buys shares in an Australian mine
A Brazilian farm ships coffee beans to Germany
A student from Kenya enrols at a Sydney university
A video from Korea is watched by viewers in Peru
a.why: Buying shares moves investment money from one country to another. Shipping coffee is a flow of goods, the student is a flow of people, and the video is a flow of ideas. The coffee is tempting because it is sold for money, but the thing that moves is the product.
a.clue: Which one moves funds rather than a product, person or message?

b.q: Hana in Perth buys a jacket designed in Italy and sewn in Vietnam, after seeing it on a video app. Which statement best describes what this shows?
opts: Several flows link three distant places in one purchase
Only a flow of goods is involved, as she bought a product
The jacket is a flow of money between Italy and Vietnam
Globalisation only happens when people travel overseas
b.why: The jacket crossing borders is a flow of goods, the video that led her to buy it is a flow of ideas, and her payment is a flow of money. So more than one flow links the places. Saying only goods are involved is tempting, but it ignores the video and the payment.
b.clue: Look for the video, the product and the payment.

a.best: A Japanese company buys shares in an Australian mine

b.best: Several flows link three distant places in one purchase
